alerts.title: Getting target banned because of my banner/nameplate for a character I’ve never played a minute in my life
alerts.summary: I have the setting on to hide my username at the beginning of matches and only have nameplates equipped. Sometimes I like to switch up my nameplates before a match because: a) in case a previous teammate is now on the enemy team (avoid being recognized) b) I like the variety c) they’re just rly cool designs Recently I’ve been having psylocke equipped (have 0 minutes on her) and the enemy team would keep on banning her even though she’s rarely/never a part of the ban picks this season 😭 Have tried it with other characters as well and sometimes it works too 😂 it’s just funny submitted by /u/jadedjed1 to r/marvelrivals [link] [comments]
